description: This file contains abstract test class for testing property editors related to OpenMRS objects within the openmrs-core project. It provides common test cases for setting and retrieving text-based representations of OpenMRS objects, ensuring correct handling of existing, non-existing, UUID, and null values.

classes.name: BasePropertyEditorTest
classes.description: An abstract base test class for property editors handling OpenMRS objects, providing common testing logic for set/get operations, including handling of non-existent IDs and UUIDs, null and empty values.

methods.name: getNewEditor
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to return a new instance of the property editor under test.

methods.name: getExistingObject
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to provide an existing OpenMRS object for testing.

methods.name: getNonExistingObjectId
methods.description: Returns a string representing an ID that does not correspond to any existing object, used for testing behavior with nonexistent IDs.

methods.name: getNonExistingObjectUuid
methods.description: Returns a UUID string that does not match any existing object, used for testing behavior with nonexistent UUIDs.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the editor before each test by calling the concrete getNewEditor method.
